name: sol_basics_pu_4
description: Missing/weak access control on UUPS _authorizeUpgrade allowing unauthorized upgrades
question: The source file in `source` defines a UUPS upgradeable contract overriding `_authorizeUpgrade(address)` but the function lacks any access-control restriction (or uses an easily bypassed/incorrect check) such that any address, not just a trusted owner/admin role, can call `upgradeTo`/`upgradeToAndCall` to change the implementation contract, excluding cases where `_authorizeUpgrade` is properly restricted with `onlyOwner`, a role-based modifier, or an equivalent correctly enforced authorization check.
criteria: _authorizeUpgrade(address) is overridden with an empty body, granting anyone permission to upgrade
_authorizeUpgrade(address) contains no modifier or require statement checking msg.sender against an owner or admin role
_authorizeUpgrade(address) checks a condition unrelated to caller authorization (e.g., always true or a tautology) instead of verifying privilege
_authorizeUpgrade(address) relies on a role check against a variable that is never initialized or is settable by any user
